title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust is the first protocol that embeds trust metrics directly into navigation systems, ensuring safe, verifiable AI behavior.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking is essential to measure trustworthiness objectively—without it, we can’t know if any protocol actually works.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust uses real-world metrics like path accuracy and failure rates, validated across multiple environments and user feedback.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking drives innovation by exposing weaknesses—no protocol is perfect without rigorous testing and comparison.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust isn’t just a benchmark—it’s the protocol that defines trust in embodied navigation.
